verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs say it generates AI meeting summaries, suggested AI action items, decisions and topic-based minutes for every meeting, which are AI suggestions drawn from the user's data inside the product. Broader in-product insight is thin: 'Ask Fellow' appears only as a pricing-page label with no description. The MCP-based Q&A runs in external AI tools, so it is not credited as an in-product capability. missing for 10: documented in-product cross-meeting insights or Q&A (Ask Fellow is undescribed), proactive suggestions beyond per-meeting summaries and action items, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
